title: 7Cav - Enlistment Reminder
description: Hourly cron that reminds the processing team when an enlistment application has sat in the queue past the deadline with no processing status prefix on it, posting one neutral note per thread.

SV/MultiPrefix: Multi Prefix 2.17.2+ (SV numbers releases by timestamp, not XenForo's AABBCCDE scheme, so the floor is the version_id of the 2.17.2 this was built and verified against)
